description: This PHP file defines the `DetailViewMerge` class, which extends `EditViewMerge` to handle merging of metadata for detail views in the SuiteCRM module. It specifies the view parameter as 'DetailView' and includes methods to parse, rename, and merge view metadata fields for the detail view interface.

classes.name: DetailViewMerge
classes.description: A class extending `EditViewMerge` specifically for merging the 'DetailView' metadata in SuiteCRM. It customizes the view parameter and handles field renaming and panel analysis for detail views.

methods.name: mergeMetaData
methods.description: Parses and merges the metadata for the detail view, including field renaming based on module-specific mappings, analysis of panels, and invoking merge functions for fields and templates.
